title: Azure .net engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Azure .net engineer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

20+ years exp as a. NET Engineer

Location: Brazil (Remote)

Work Hours: U. S. Eastern Time Zone (ET) ± 1 hour

Role Overview

We are seeking a senior nearshore engineer based in Brazil with deep, hands-on Azure development experience, focused on modernizing enterprise. NET/C# applications into Azure-native architectures, with a primary emphasis on Azure Functions and supporting Azure services.

This role supports large-scale enterprise and cloud modernization initiatives. The ideal candidate has strong experience working in corporate environments, is comfortable in a nearshore delivery model, and can operate as a seamless extension of a U. S.-based engineering team.

Required Experience & Core Qualifications

10+ years of experience in enterprise / corporate technology environments Strong Azure development background, with production experience in Azure-native services Proven experience supporting U. S.-based or English-speaking organizations (or English-language higher education) – nice to have Strong verbal and written English communication skills Experience working in a near-shore or distributed delivery model Ability to align working hours with U. S. Eastern Time (ET) ± 1 hour Reliable home office setup (monitor and keyboard required; laptop provided)

Primary Technical Focus (Must Have)

Azure &. NET Development (Primary Focus)

. NET / C# Deep experience with. NET Framework and. NET Core /. NET Strong C# development fundamentals in enterprise environments Azure Functions Hands-on experience designing, building, and maintaining Azure Functions Experience refactoring or modernizing existing. NET applications into serverless or Azure-native architectures Familiarity with triggers, bindings, scaling, error handling, and monitoring Core Azure Services Practical experience with services commonly used alongside Azure Functions, such as: Azure App Service Azure Storage (Blob, Queue, Table) Azure Service Bus or Event Grid Azure Key Vault Azure Monitor / Application Insights Cloud Readiness & Modernization Experience modernizing monolithic or legacy middleware into Azure-based solutions Understanding of cloud design patterns, resiliency, and scalability

Secondary Technical Focus (Strongly Preferred)

SQL Server & Data Platforms (Second Priority)

SQL Server (2016+) Strong experience with SQL Server in enterprise environments Exposure to on-premises to Azure SQL or Azure SQL Managed Instance migrations Experience modernizing: Linked servers SQL Agent jobs SSRS (SQL Server Reporting Services) SSAS experience is a plus Ability to design and optimize database interactions for cloud-based workloads

API, Security, and Front-End

API Development Experience with REST and SOAP services Understanding of API design best practices and documentation (Swagger / Open API) Authentication & Authorization Familiarity with enterprise authentication patterns: OAuth, SAML, Open ID Connect (OIDC) Azure Entra (Azure AD) Angular Experience supporting or maintaining Angular-based front-end applications Python Used for scripting, automation, or auxiliary workloads Azure Data Factory or other ETL tools

Supporting Skills (Nice to Have / Lower Priority)

Oracle (intermediate experience; exposure to migrations is a plus) Snowflake (familiarity with cloud analytics publishing patterns)

Engagement & Delivery Expectations

Operate as a contracted nearshore resource, integrated into an existing Azure delivery team Participate in Agile ceremonies, design discussions, and code reviews Follow enterprise standards for security, documentation, and SDLC Deliver high-quality, production-ready Azure solutions

title: Fullstack developer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Fullstack developer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Description

We are looking for a versatile and talented Full-stack Developer to grow with our global development team. You will be working remotely on the main Assima platform application. Your key role will be to implement features and maintain our platform developed in C# and. NET framework.

title: Direct-response ad video editor
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Direct-response ad video editor em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We're looking for a direct response video editor who can produce 1-3 performance ads per day — consistently, quickly, and without hand-holding.

You'll receive reference ads, raw footage, AI-generated visuals, voiceover audio, product photography, UGC clips, and creative briefs. Your job is to turn those inputs into scroll-stopping Meta ads that look native to the feed, follow direct response principles, and are ready to launch same-day.

Some days you'll get a detailed brief with every asset handed to you. Other days you'll get a reference ad and a direction — and you'll need to reverse-engineer the structure, build a visual concept, and deliver a finished ad using your own creative instincts.

This is not a 9-to-5 editing job. This is a performance marketing role that happens to live inside an editing timeline.

What You'll Be Doing

Editing 1-3 short-form video ads per day (15-60 seconds) for Meta placements Working with a mix of UGC footage, AI-generated imagery, 3 D medical-style animations, product photography, voiceover tracks, and b-roll Receiving reference ads and reverse-engineering their pacing, structure, visual rhythm, and caption systems to build Velor Health versions Building ads from creative briefs that include scripts, shot lists, visual direction, and caption specs Originating new ad concepts when given only a direction or angle — proposing visual treatments, caption styles, and pacing without being told exactly what to do Implementing caption systems with color-coded text (white/red/blue pill captions, green keyword highlights, auto-generated Tik Tok-style captions) depending on the ad format Cutting multiple versions of the same ad (hook variants, length variants, aspect ratio variants) for A/B testing Maintaining a fast turnaround — most ads should go from brief to finished export within 2-4 hours Organizing and managing a growing library of raw assets, finished ads, and creative templates

What You Need

Proven experience editing direct response or performance marketing video ads (not brand content, not music videos, not wedding films — direct response ads that ran on Meta or Tik Tok with measurable results) Fluency in Cap Cut, Premiere Pro, or After Effects — whichever you're fastest in Strong understanding of Meta ad formats — you know what a native feed ad looks like versus a produced commercial, and you default to native Ability to match reference ad pacing intuitively — if we send you a competitor ad, you can deconstruct its cut timing, caption rhythm, and visual structure without being taught Comfort working with AI-generated imagery and integrating it seamlessly into live footage and product photography Experience with caption styling — you've built caption systems before (color-coded, keyword-highlighted, timed to VO) and you understand that captions are a conversion tool, not an accessibility afterthought A sharp eye for thumbnail-level scroll-stopping — you understand that the first frame of a video ad is a static image in the feed and you treat it accordingly Ability to self-manage, meet daily output targets, and communicate proactively when something is unclear or delayed Reliable internet connection and availability during US business hours (ET or CT preferred but flexible for the right person)

Bonus (Not Required)

Experience editing ads in the health, wellness, fitness, or DTC supplement space Familiarity with the \"ugly ad\" aesthetic — ads intentionally designed to look like organic UGC rather than polished production Experience with motion graphics or basic After Effects animation (for text overlays, simple transitions, or kinetic typography) Understanding of direct response copywriting principles (you know why a hook matters, why the product should appear early, why the CTA needs to sound like a peer recommendation)

What You Don't Need

A film degree A fancy reel of cinematic work Experience at a big agency Color grading expertise

We care about speed, instinct, and output quality at volume. If your best work is a single beautifully-graded 3-minute brand film, this isn't the right fit. If your best work is 47 Meta ads you cut last month that all drove profitable ROAS, we want to talk to you.

Compensation

Competitive rate based on experience. This is a contract role with potential to grow into a long-term position as the brand scales. We value speed and consistency — editors who hit daily output targets reliably will have no shortage of work.

How To Apply

There will be a paid test before any hire is made. Here's how it works:

Apply with your portfolio. Send 3-5 examples of direct response video ads you've edited that actually ran on Meta or Tik Tok. Tell us the niche, the objective, and the result if you have it. We don't need a sizzle reel — we need proof you've done this before. If your portfolio fits, we'll send you a paid test project. You'll receive a reference ad, a script, raw assets (footage, images, voiceover), and a creative brief. You'll have 24 hours to deliver a finished ad. This test is paid regardless of whether you're hired. We evaluate the test on four criteria: Did you match the pacing and structure of the reference? Did the first frame stop the scroll? Did the captions and visual rhythm support the VO? Did you deliver on time? If the test passes, you start with a one-week trial at 1 ad per day. If that week goes well, we scale to full output.

We're not looking for perfection. We're looking for someone who ships fast, learns from references quickly, and gets better with every ad they cut.

To apply, send your portfolio and a brief note about your direct response editing experience to (your email) with the subject line \"DR Editor — (Your Name).\"

title: Ai quality analyst (portgugal portuguese )
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Ai quality analyst (portgugal portuguese ) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Company Description:

Million Logics is a trusted Oracle Partner and global leader in IT solutions, with operations in London, UK, and a development hub in Hyderabad, India. Specialising in innovative and scalable services, Million Logics empowers enterprises through data & AI, cloud solutions, IT consulting, and custom application development. With a team of 85+ AI/ML experts, we deliver tailored solutions that foster digital transformation and operational excellence. We are committed to client success. We blend world-class technical expertise with strategic insight to deliver results.

Role Overview:

As an AI Quality Analyst, you will evaluate a new personalisation feature for Gemini. You will assess how well the model uses information from your past Gemini conversations, Gmail, Google Search, and You Tube activity to make responses more relevant and helpful. This role requires a unique blend of creativity and analytical rigour. You will actively design prompts from the perspective of your own personal experiences. You will then use your analytical skills to assess the quality of the model's personalised responses, evaluating dimensions such as Grounding, Integration, and Helpfulness.

Offer Details:

Duration of Contract: 6 months Pay: $1500 per month (net/take-home) Mode of work: Fully Remote Number of Positions: 20 Must have fluency in Portgutal Portuguese (not Brazilian Portuguese )

Skills:

Experience in data annotation, AI quality evaluation, content moderation, or a related role is strongly preferred. BS/BA degree or equivalent experience in a relevant field (e.g., Policy, Law, Ethics, Linguistics, Journalism, Computer Science, or a related analytical field).

Key Qualifications:

Portuguese Proficiency: Ability to read and write in Portgutal Portuguese (not Brazilian Portuguese ) with a high degree of comp, as Portuguese is the focus language for this project. Personal Account Usage: Willingness to use your primary personal Google account (not a testing account) and enable personal data sources for a genuine assessment. Schedule Flexibility: Full-time availability in your local time zone is required. We are staffing a global, 24-hour operations team. Exceptional Analytical Thinking: Demonstrate ability to evaluate nuanced and ambiguous AI responses, specifically assessing personalisation quality. Creative Prompt Engineering: Experience in designing creative, multi-turn starting prompts based on personal context to thoroughly test the model's capabilities. Strong Evaluation Acumen: Understanding of personalisation concepts, including the ability to identify incorrect personalisation, poor inferences, and forced connections. Meticulous Attention to Detail: The ability to review Side-by-Side (Sx S) model responses and spot subtle differences in naturalness and over-narrating. Excellent Written Communication: Superior ability to write clear, concise, and structured rationales for model rankings, explicitly referencing specific turn numbers. Feedback: Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations. Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting. Technical Setup: Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.

Description:

In this role, you will be part of a dynamic team focused on evaluating the quality of personalised AI interactions. Your day-to-day work will involve: Designing and executing multi-turn conversational prompts (typically 1-5 turns) that require the AI to utilise your personal information and experiences. Evaluating model responses based on your intent from the starting prompt, checking if the personalisation was appropriately applied. Analysing responses for Grounding issues, ensuring claims about you are supported by evidence and not flawed inferences or hallucinations. Assessing Integration quality to ensure personal data is woven naturally into the response without robotic \"over-narrating\". Rigorously evaluating and stack-ranking two model responses side-by-side (Sx S) to determine which is overall more helpful, easy to use, and enjoyable. Writing clear, defensible rationales for your comparisons, explicitly referencing where issues or positive aspects occurred in the conversation. Extracting and verifying \"Debug Info\" from the model to confirm that chat summaries and data sources were properly utilised. Maintaining strict data hygiene by deleting evaluation conversations to prevent them from polluting your future chat history.

Education & Experience:

BS/BA degree or equivalent experience in a relevant field (e.g., Policy, Law, Ethics, Linguistics, Journalism, Computer Science, or a related analytical field). Experience in data annotation, AI quality evaluation, content moderation, or a related role is strongly preferred.

Additional Details:

Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and up to 40 hours per week, with 4 hours of overlap with PST. Engagement type: Contractor Engagement Length: 6 months

title: Applied ai engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Applied ai engineer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Applied AI Engineer Who We Are

Enlightened Today is a rapidly expanding and innovative company leading the charge in the spiritual and wellness space. We are dedicated to changing the industry with bold, creative marketing strategies and forward-thinking technical solutions. Our team thrives on collaboration, innovation, and crafting content that deeply resonates with our audience. Our business model centers on creating authentic connections with our audience through digital channels and delivering premium services and products that meet their needs. The role

This is a hands-on, embedded engineering role. Instead of sitting behind a backlog and building to spec, you'll embed directly with the founders and the team, figure out what the business actually needs (which is often not what was first asked for), and ship working AI solutions fast. You'll move fluidly between building AI agents, shipping customer-facing AI products, and wiring up the data that feeds both, talking to the people who'll use what you build, iterating in front of them, and turning rough ideas into things that work.

In short: part engineer, part solutions architect, part builder-who-talks-to-humans. You'll be deployed against our own business and customers rather than external clients, but the instincts are the same: high autonomy, fast prototyping, strong communication, and a bias toward shipping something useful over perfecting something slowly.

This is a \"hire for talent\" role, and we care far more about what you can build and how you think than about your years of experience or pedigree. If you're early-career but exceptional, or senior and want to get your hands dirty again, both are welcome. What you'll build

You'll lead or contribute to three flagship initiatives:

Agentic orchestration. We run our development and operations on an internal system of specialized AI agents, built on Claude Code, that plan, build, and review each other's work before anything ships, with reusable skills and adversarial review gates that keep quality high. You'll operate it, extend it, build new agents and skills for our specific workflows, and keep those quality gates sharp. Conversational AI grounded in the customer. Build AI chat and voice experiences that tap into a customer's profile and behavioral signals to have genuinely helpful, personalized conversations with them about their relationship and life questions, the core of what our customers come to us for. This spans retrieval over customer profiles, conversation memory, and (on the roadmap) real-time voice. Signal-based personalized marketing. Turn customer signals into tailored marketing: segments, scoring, and personalized messaging pushed through our marketing stack. This extends our existing lead-intelligence pipeline.

You won't do all three every week, but over a quarter you'll likely touch all of them. Our stack

AI / LLM: Claude (API + Claude Code), multi-agent orchestration, prompt and skill authoring, Eleven Labs for voice Primary language: Python Backend / data: Postgres / Supabase (incl. pgvector), REST APIs Frontend: Next.js, React, Vercel, HTML/CSS Marketing infra: Klaviyo, Checkout Champ, Hyros, attribution and CRM tools Tooling: Git/Git Hub, CI, modern AI-assisted dev workflows (some of our agent tooling touches shell + Type Script/Node)

You don't need every item on this list. You do need to be the kind of person who picks up a new tool quickly and ships with it. What we're looking for

Hands-on, embedded instincts: you can sit with a non-technical stakeholder, diagnose what they actually need, and turn it into something working, fast, and without a detailed spec Strong communication: you'll work directly with the founders and explain your work to non-engineers clearly Strong Python and solid full-stack fundamentals, comfortable across backend logic, data, and a functional frontend Real, hands-on LLM experience: prompting, retrieval (RAG), chaining, evaluating outputs, and handling the messy reality of non-deterministic systems Agentic experience: you've built or seriously operated multi-agent systems and understand orchestration, tool/function calling, and review/eval loops Fluency with AI-assisted development: you use tools like Claude Code daily and know how to get great output from them Solid engineering discipline: testing (we value TDD), clean Git workflows, and the judgment to build quality gates rather than skip them Comfortable in shell and Type Script/Node when the tooling calls for it, and you don't have to be an expert, but you can't be allergic to it A bias toward shipping: working software over perfect software Sound judgment around sensitive, emotional conversations. Our customers come to us about love and relationships; AI that talks with them needs guardrails, scope limits, escalation paths, and clear boundaries built in. We treat this as a design requirement, not an afterthought Care with personal data: customer profiles and conversation content are sensitive (consent, data minimization, secure storage, CCPA) Nice to have Prior solutions-engineering, founder, or consulting experience, or anything that put you face-to-face with the people you build for Experience with conversational/voice AI: TTS/STT, low-latency streaming, voice-agent frameworks (Live Kit, Pipecat, Vapi) Experience in DTC e-commerce, subscriptions, or performance marketing Familiarity with attribution/CRM platforms and marketing APIs Recommendation, personalization, or feature-store experience Familiarity with agentic frameworks (Lang Graph, Crew AI, Auto Gen, or similar) and the Agent Skills pattern A portfolio of shipped products, repos, demos, or AI projects we can look at Why this role is different Genuine ownership. Direct access to the founders, no layers of approval, and the ability to ship to real customers fast. You're close to the problem. You won't be handed tickets in isolation. You'll sit with the business, see the real need, and build for it directly. AI-native by default. You'll orchestrate AI agents rather than type every line, the way the best engineers will work in a few years. Breadth. If you're tired of being a cog on one narrow feature, this is the opposite. You'll touch the whole business. How to apply

Record a 3-minute video introducing yourself along with your resume to Tell us why you're excited about this role, and a few things we should know about you, professionally and personally.

title: Applied ai engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Applied ai engineer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Applied AI Engineer Who We Are

Enlightened Today is a rapidly expanding and innovative company leading the charge in the spiritual and wellness space. We are dedicated to changing the industry with bold, creative marketing strategies and forward-thinking technical solutions. Our team thrives on collaboration, innovation, and crafting content that deeply resonates with our audience. Our business model centers on creating authentic connections with our audience through digital channels and delivering premium services and products that meet their needs. The role

This is a hands-on, embedded engineering role. Instead of sitting behind a backlog and building to spec, you'll embed directly with the founders and the team, figure out what the business actually needs (which is often not what was first asked for), and ship working AI solutions fast. You'll move fluidly between building AI agents, shipping customer-facing AI products, and wiring up the data that feeds both, talking to the people who'll use what you build, iterating in front of them, and turning rough ideas into things that work.

In short: part engineer, part solutions architect, part builder-who-talks-to-humans. You'll be deployed against our own business and customers rather than external clients, but the instincts are the same: high autonomy, fast prototyping, strong communication, and a bias toward shipping something useful over perfecting something slowly.

This is a \"hire for talent\" role, and we care far more about what you can build and how you think than about your years of experience or pedigree. If you're early-career but exceptional, or senior and want to get your hands dirty again, both are welcome. What you'll build

You'll lead or contribute to three flagship initiatives:

Agentic orchestration. We run our development and operations on an internal system of specialized AI agents, built on Claude Code, that plan, build, and review each other's work before anything ships, with reusable skills and adversarial review gates that keep quality high. You'll operate it, extend it, build new agents and skills for our specific workflows, and keep those quality gates sharp. Conversational AI grounded in the customer. Build AI chat and voice experiences that tap into a customer's profile and behavioral signals to have genuinely helpful, personalized conversations with them about their relationship and life questions, the core of what our customers come to us for. This spans retrieval over customer profiles, conversation memory, and (on the roadmap) real-time voice. Signal-based personalized marketing. Turn customer signals into tailored marketing: segments, scoring, and personalized messaging pushed through our marketing stack. This extends our existing lead-intelligence pipeline.

You won't do all three every week, but over a quarter you'll likely touch all of them. Our stack

AI / LLM: Claude (API + Claude Code), multi-agent orchestration, prompt and skill authoring, Eleven Labs for voice Primary language: Python Backend / data: Postgres / Supabase (incl. pgvector), REST APIs Frontend: Next.js, React, Vercel, HTML/CSS Marketing infra: Klaviyo, Checkout Champ, Hyros, attribution and CRM tools Tooling: Git/Git Hub, CI, modern AI-assisted dev workflows (some of our agent tooling touches shell + Type Script/Node)

You don't need every item on this list. You do need to be the kind of person who picks up a new tool quickly and ships with it. What we're looking for

Hands-on, embedded instincts: you can sit with a non-technical stakeholder, diagnose what they actually need, and turn it into something working, fast, and without a detailed spec Strong communication: you'll work directly with the founders and explain your work to non-engineers clearly Strong Python and solid full-stack fundamentals, comfortable across backend logic, data, and a functional frontend Real, hands-on LLM experience: prompting, retrieval (RAG), chaining, evaluating outputs, and handling the messy reality of non-deterministic systems Agentic experience: you've built or seriously operated multi-agent systems and understand orchestration, tool/function calling, and review/eval loops Fluency with AI-assisted development: you use tools like Claude Code daily and know how to get great output from them Solid engineering discipline: testing (we value TDD), clean Git workflows, and the judgment to build quality gates rather than skip them Comfortable in shell and Type Script/Node when the tooling calls for it, and you don't have to be an expert, but you can't be allergic to it A bias toward shipping: working software over perfect software Sound judgment around sensitive, emotional conversations. Our customers come to us about love and relationships; AI that talks with them needs guardrails, scope limits, escalation paths, and clear boundaries built in. We treat this as a design requirement, not an afterthought Care with personal data: customer profiles and conversation content are sensitive (consent, data minimization, secure storage, CCPA) Nice to have Prior solutions-engineering, founder, or consulting experience, or anything that put you face-to-face with the people you build for Experience with conversational/voice AI: TTS/STT, low-latency streaming, voice-agent frameworks (Live Kit, Pipecat, Vapi) Experience in DTC e-commerce, subscriptions, or performance marketing Familiarity with attribution/CRM platforms and marketing APIs Recommendation, personalization, or feature-store experience Familiarity with agentic frameworks (Lang Graph, Crew AI, Auto Gen, or similar) and the Agent Skills pattern A portfolio of shipped products, repos, demos, or AI projects we can look at Why this role is different Genuine ownership. Direct access to the founders, no layers of approval, and the ability to ship to real customers fast. You're close to the problem. You won't be handed tickets in isolation. You'll sit with the business, see the real need, and build for it directly. AI-native by default. You'll orchestrate AI agents rather than type every line, the way the best engineers will work in a few years. Breadth. If you're tired of being a cog on one narrow feature, this is the opposite. You'll touch the whole business. How to apply

Record a 3-minute video introducing yourself along with your resume to Tell us why you're excited about this role, and a few things we should know about you, professionally and personally.

title: Professor(a) de inglês corporativo — remoto pj
description:

Professor(a) de Inglês Corporativo — Remoto | PJ

A Atlas English é um curso intensivo de inglês online com metodologia própria, voltado 100% para o ambiente profissional. Turmas de até 5 alunos, 4 meses de duração.

Experiência com Business English. Disponibilidade para aulas principalmente antes das 9h e/ou após as 18h (nossos alunos são profissionais em horário comercial). Disponibilidade de segunda a sexta, eventualmente aos sábados pela manhã. Inglês fluente ou nativo. Conexão de internet estável.

title: Sdr (brasil)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Sdr (brasil) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Remote | Part-Time | (BRL) R$1,500–R$2,000/month + Uncapped Performance Bonuses

Important: We are a fast-growing UK-based performance marketing agency working with English-speaking clients, and this role requires fluent spoken English. However, compensation for this position is paid in Brazilian Reais (BRL) and not in USD, GBP, or EUR.

If you're applying because you're expecting international-level compensation due to the English requirement or our UK location, this role is probably not the right fit.

We're looking for ambitious people who want to join a growing company, develop their skills, earn performance-based bonuses, and grow into a larger role over time. High performers are rewarded here, and strong results can lead to significantly higher earnings and career progression.

About the Role

We're looking for a confident, organised, and proactive SDR to help both our clients and our agency grow.

You'll be responsible for handling inbound leads, following up consistently, booking consultations, and prospecting new business opportunities. This is a hands-on sales role for someone who enjoys speaking with people, taking ownership, and being measured by results.

What You'll Do

Call inbound leads quickly after they submit an enquiry Book qualified prospects into consultations Follow up consistently with warm and cold leads Handle objections professionally and confidently Prospect new agency clients through cold calling, email, social media outreach, and direct messaging Maintain accurate records in the CRM Keep pipelines organised and up to date Work closely with the marketing team Report daily activity and results

English Requirement (Please Read Carefully)

Fluent spoken English is non-negotiable.

This role involves communicating with English-speaking prospects and clients regularly.

You must be able to:

Hold natural conversations entirely in English Build rapport confidently on live calls Understand different English accents Communicate clearly without relying on scripts or translation tools Handle objections and sales conversations naturally

Professional working proficiency or intermediate English is not sufficient for this role.

If you cannot comfortably hold a 15–20 minute sales conversation entirely in English, this role is probably not the right fit.

What We're Looking For

Strong spoken English Comfortable making a high volume of calls Experience with cold calling and sales outreach Experience using CRM systems (Go High Level preferred) Highly organised and reliable Self-motivated and proactive Strong sense of ownership and accountability Coachable and willing to improve continuously Results-oriented mindset

This Role Is NOT For You If

You need constant supervision or hand-holding You wait to be told what to do You make excuses instead of taking action You're looking for an easy, low-effort position You avoid accountability when results don't go your way You dislike making calls or speaking with prospects

This Role IS For You If

You take initiative without being asked You enjoy sales and client communication You take ownership of your results You're ambitious and hungry to grow You thrive in a performance-based environment You want your effort and results to be recognised and rewarded

Bonus Points

Experience working with UK or US clients Experience booking consultations Experience selling high-ticket services Familiarity with marketing funnels Familiarity with CRM automations Experience using Go High Level

Compensation & Growth

Base salary: R$1,500–R$2,000/month (paid in BRL) Uncapped performance bonuses Opportunity to progress into a full-time role Fast-growing company with genuine career progression opportunities

We believe in rewarding performance, initiative, and ownership. The people who consistently create results are the people who grow fastest within our company.

How to Apply

Please submit:

A 60-second voice note in English introducing yourself A 2-minute unedited video in English explaining your previous sales experience and why you'd be a good fit for this role Applications that does not include one of the recordings will not be considered.

title: Coordinador de planeamiento supply chain
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Coordinador de planeamiento supply chain em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Empresa con gran trayectoria y de alcance internacional, se encuentra en la búsqueda de un talento: Coordinador de Planeamiento y Demanda¿Cuál es la Misión del puesto?Liderar, integrar y hacer eficientes los procesos implicados en la cadena de suministro como son: estimación de la demanda, planificación de la cadena de abastecimiento, compras estratégicas, operaciones de planta y logística y transporte, lo cual implica una interacción y coordinación de acciones constante con los distintos referentes de áreas. Definir el plan de demanda, plan de abastecimiento a los COs, producción y abastecimiento de materias primas e insumos, liderando a su equipo para que se realice de acuerdo a lo acordado. Liderar los planes Estratégicos y planes de mediano y corto plazo de su área, así como liderar y desarrollar a su equipo en pos de la incorporación de prácticas modernas de Planeamiento. Plantear los objetivos del área en forma alineada con los objetivos de la Gerencia de Supply Chain y la Gerencia Corporativa. Liderar y acompañar en la mejora continua del portafolio de la compañía a través del Proceso de Racionalización de SKUs (Cure & Kill) a partir de comités multifuncionales con los diversos actores a lo largo de la Cadena de Suministro. Coordinar con las áreas de la compañía las tareas de limpieza de datos y mejora de procesos de ciclo de vida del producto. Asegurar que no se tengan quiebres a través del correcto balance de producción y abastecimiento a COs oportunamente. Velar por el Working Capital de la compañía a través de la administración de los inventarios de PT, MP y Repuestos. Contribuir y velar por el buen clima laboral, coordinando y participando en las diferentes actividades que se desarrollen en coordinación con las otras jefaturas de la empresa. Cumplir con las políticas y lineamientos de la empresa, del sistema integrado de gestión, política de las 5 S, el RIT y el código de ética, así como del marco normativo del gobierno con la finalidad de contribuir con el desarrollo óptimo y adecuado de las diferentes actividades de la organización.¿Cuáles son los requisitos del puesto?Titulado en Administración, Ingeniería Industriasl o carreras afines. Contar con 3 años de experiencia viendo procesos S&OP y manejo de presupuesto. (Indispensable) Conocimiento en SAP y Office (Indispensable) Nivel de inglés Intermedio/avanzado (Deseable). Conocimientos en gestión de procesos, gestión por competencia y gestión al cambio.¿Qué te ofrecemos?Formar parte de una empresa líder en su sector. Planilla Completa.

As Blueclip we started our journey to bring the most creative minds and the know-how together to deliver great works. Our current search is for a journalist/writer for entertainment content.

Your primary responsibility will be writing taglines and pinned comments for content creators and communicating with fans in comment sections.

Create a variety of text for various social networking networks (taglines, pinned comments, descriptions, etc). Use analytics to gain interesting insights and comments on your writing. Please upload your English CV.

title: Médico pediatra (rqe)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Médico pediatra (rqe) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

*OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO PEDIATRA (com RQE) NA TELADOC HEALTH\"

Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital!

A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicos e Médicas Especialistas em Pediatria! Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando.

*SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH:*

A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas.

*O QUE PROCURAMOS:*

Estamos em busca de Médico/a Pediatra, comprometidos e capacitados para se juntarem à nossa equipe multidisciplinar. Nosso time de médicos desempenham um papel crucial no suporte dos pacientes, para sanar suas dúvidas, atender as demandas de saúde de acordo com a necessidade de cada um, através de nossa plataforma online. Se você é um profissional licenciado, focado em resultados e apaixonado por fazer a diferença na vida dos pacientes, queremos conhecer você!

O médico será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, na modalidade especialidade em Pediatria, de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos;

PAPEL E RESPONSABILIDADES

Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em Pediatria de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação. Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de crianças e adolescentes em suas múltiplas facetas e condições. Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de conduzir anamnese virtual para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de risco e gravidade em Pediatria e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial. Competência na avaliação pediátrica, incluindo o reconhecimento de problemas e doenças que possam estar presente nesta faixa etária. Habilidade em conduzir entrevistas detalhadas e observar sintomas e sinais através de vídeochamada com o responsável. Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa. Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente. Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças de acordo com o diagnóstico e faixa etária. Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina. Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento. Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde da criança e do adolescente. Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca dos principais problemas de saúde em Pediatria. Garantir o respeito ao ECA (Estatuto da Criança e do Adolescente) com respeito aos seus direitos e prerrogativas para o cuidado em saúde. Realizar consulta individualizada ao adolescente sem necessidade de responsável a partir dos 12 anos de idade conforme previsto pelo ECA (Estatuto da Criança e do Adolescente), caso solicitado ou quando avaliada necessária. Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo. Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe crianças e adolescentes a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde. Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado. Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais. Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo. Manter-se bem-informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes. Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.

REQUISITOS OBRIGATÓRIOS E PREFERÊNCIAS DE HABILIDADES

Formação Acadêmica:

Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA Obrigatório: RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO EM PEDIATRIA

Certificações:

Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM); Certificado de Título de Especialista em Pediatria - RQE emitido pelo Conselho respectivo; Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil).

Experiência:

Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em Pediatria, sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina e Atenção Primária à Saúde;

Conhecimentos Específicos para a função:

Médico competente em prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de Crianças e Adolescentes.

Competências Comportamentais:

Médico comprometido com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional.

Outros Requisitos Importantes:

Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável.

Local de Trabalho:

O Médico atuará remotamente, conduzindo suas atividades a partir de seu próprio consultório ou local de preferência, através da telemedicina.

IMPORTANTE:

MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO: Contratação em regime de Prestador de Serviços por contrato Pessoa Jurídica, necessário fazer parte como representante legal ou sócio de um CNPJ ativo.

REMUNERAÇÃO E AGENDAMENTOS: a negociar durante processo seletivo.

Esta descrição de cargo/atuação tem caráter informativo e pode ser ajustada conforme a necessidade da empresa ou instituição que oferece a oportunidade de trabalho em telemedicina para Médico Clínico/Generalista e Especialista em Pediatria.

title: Senior application architect
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior application architect em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

A T-Systems, multinacional alemã pertencente ao Grupo Deutsche Telekom, busca profissional sênior de TI com sólida experiência híbrida em arquitetura de aplicações, desenvolvimento e gerenciamento de bancos de dados, com foco particular na integração de sistemas externos por meio de tecnologias middleware como MQ, Kafka, SFTP e CFT. Especializado em ambientes COBOL e DB2 (LUW/z OS), com vasta experiência na integração de sistemas legados e plataformas distribuídas modernas.

Perfil desejado

Experiência comprovada no projeto e implementação de soluções de integração ponta a ponta, conectando aplicações mainframe com ambientes de nuvem e Linux (Azure). Sólida experiência em administração de DB2, otimização de desempenho, modelagem de dados e integração de dados, garantindo alta disponibilidade, escalabilidade e confiabilidade de sistemas de missão crítica. Experiência prática com plataformas middleware (IBM MQ, Axway CFT), protocolos de transferência de arquivos (SFTP/FTPS) e streaming de eventos (Kafka), possibilitando a troca de dados robusta e eficiente em ambientes de sistemas heterogêneos. Habilidade em analisar e resolver desafios complexos de múltiplas camadas, abrangendo aplicações, dados e infraestrutura. Experiência em automação, processamento em lote (Control-M/JCL) e modernização de ambientes legados. Reconhecido por uma mentalidade holística, orientada à arquitetura, fortes habilidades de resolução de problemas e comunicação eficaz com stakeholders técnicos e de negócios em ambientes internacionais.

Requisitos Técnicos

COBOL – experiência prática em desenvolvimento e entendimento de sistemas legados. DB2 LUW e/ou DB2 z/OS: Administração e manutenção Backups e recovery Modelagem e DDL (ex: criação de tabelas) Gerenciamento de índices Performance tuning e análise Carga e extração de dados (Load/Unload) Conhecimentos em Mainframe e sua integração com sistemas distribuídos. Cloud (Azure) e ambientes Linux, incluindo automação via scripting. Control-M / JCL – criação e administração de workflows e agendamento de jobs. IBM MQ – configuração de channels, queues e uso de ferramentas como MQ Explorer. Rocket Enterprise Server. Axway CFT – configuração de fluxos de transferência. Protocolos de transferência: SFTP, FTPS.

Idiomas

Inglês avançado (mandatório) Alemão (diferencial relevante)

Outros Requisitos

Disponibilidade para atuar no fuso horário da Alemanha.

title: Servicenow application portfolio management (apm) & data quality engineer - contractor in usd
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Servicenow application portfolio management (apm) & data quality engineer - contractor in usd em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

For our international customer in Valencia, we are looking for a Service Now Application Portfolio Management (APM) & Data Quality Engineer. The role focuses on ongoing APM data maintenance in Service Now (APM/CMDB-related records as applicable), identifying data gaps and inconsistencies, coordinating updates with application/service owners, and tracking technical debt indicators and remediation progress.

EU candidates are welcome to apply. Candidates need to be based in Valencia or willing to relocate to Valencia. Candidates need to be flexible to work across time zones, including alignment with US Eastern Time where required.

Work permit is not provided. Candidates need to be fluent in English.

Tasks and responsibilities:

Perform ongoing maintenance of Application Portfolio Management (APM) data within Service Now, including application inventory, ownership, lifecycle status, technology attributes, and documented integrations/dependencies, ensuring data accuracy, completeness, and currency; Identify and remediate data quality issues such as missing or invalid values, duplicate records, and inconsistent classifications through coordination with application owners, service owners, and relevant stakeholders; Maintain and enhance portfolio data governance standards and controlled vocabularies, including lifecycle states, business and technical fit assessments, and application criticality classifications; Monitor and track technical debt indicators leveraging Service Now portfolio data, including lifecycle and obsolescence risks, unsupported technologies, architectural non-conformities, and resilience or operability gaps; Maintain a centralized log or aligned Service Now records documenting technical debt items, including impacted applications/services, severity and priority ratings, and recommended remediation actions such as retirement, replacement, or modernization; Develop and deliver recurring dashboards, reports, and portfolio insights for the onsite Enterprise Architect, including technical debt trends, aging remediation items, progress tracking, and portfolio risk hotspots; Translate stakeholder inputs, priorities, and publishing schedules into updates for the APM website and related communication materials; Maintain and support the APM website as a central platform for publishing portfolio data, standards, insights, lifecycle guidance, and reference information related to Application Portfolio Management practices;

Profile:

Master's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline; +8 years of overall experience in Information Technology; +3 years of experience supporting Enterprise Architects or working within Enterprise Architecture teams; Hands-on experience with Service Now, specifically supporting Application Portfolio Management (APM) data, including application and CMDB records, data validation, monitoring, maintenance, and reporting; Strong understanding of Application Portfolio Management (APM) principles, including application inventory management, lifecycle governance, business and technical fit assessments, risk and obsolescence analysis, and application rationalization strategies (retire, replace, modernize); Proven experience identifying, documenting, and tracking technical debt, including the definition of debt indicators, maintenance of remediation records, and generation of actionable reporting and insights; Solid understanding of Enterprise Architecture concepts and practices, including architecture principles, standards, governance, target-state architecture, roadmaps, and architecture deliverables, as well as the role of portfolio data in strategic decision-making; Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with distributed stakeholders to resolve data quality issues and drive timely completion of application and portfolio record updates; Previous experience delivering similar Service Now APM and technical debt management activities within large or complex enterprise environments is highly preferred; Strong analytical, reporting, and problem-solving capabilities, including experience producing dashboards, scorecards, KPI reporting, and trend analysis with a strong focus on data integrity and attention to detail; AI literacy, including practical experience using AI and Generative AI tools to enhance productivity in areas such as data analysis, reporting, documentation, and knowledge management, within approved enterprise governance frameworks; Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to document processes, prepare executive-ready materials, and communicate findings effectively to Enterprise Architects and business stakeholders; Working knowledge of Enterprise Architecture frameworks and methodologies such as TOGAF and their practical application in enterprise architecture deliverables and governance processes; Working knowledge of Service Now data model fundamentals relevant to Application Portfolio Management, including CMDB structures, application records, CSDM concepts, and portfolio data governance practices; Relevant certifications are considered an advantage, including:

TOGAF or equivalent Enterprise Architecture certification;

Service Now Certified System Administrator (CSA);

Service Now Certified Application Developer (CAD) and/or relevant Service Now implementation certifications related to APM or CMDB;

Experience with enterprise architecture and portfolio management tooling, including Service Now EA Workspace and APM reporting capabilities, is considered a plus; Familiarity with responsible AI principles and the secure use of enterprise AI assistants, including prompt hygiene and protection of sensitive information, is considered an advantage; Fluent in English;

title: Talent data analyst - remote
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Talent data analyst - remote em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.

Overview of the role:

We are looking for a Talent Data Analyst to join our Talent team. This professional will be responsible for taking raw information – numbers or qualitative data sets – and constructing narratives that help our business colleagues to make better decisions. The primary goal of this position is to take large volumes of complex data from our Talent team, extract insights, and help solve problems.

Key responsibilities:

- Understand the Talent funnel and architect a Data solution from scratch, including the definition of KPIs and metrics.

- Work with stakeholders to understand reporting needs, identifying and querying data sources to get the required data.

- Cleanse and massage data into the shape required, creating datasets, reports, and dashboards to meet requirements.

- Present and gather feedback from stakeholders.

- Deploy data, reports, and dashboards to Data Analysis tools, developing reports according to analyst-defined specifications.

- Maintain and document the operational environment.

Requirements:

- At least 3 years of experience developing Business Intelligence dashboards and reports, analyzing, and visualizing data.

- An understanding of top-of-the-line Data Analysis tools. Previous experience with administration, licensing, security, and deployment is a plus.

- A solid understanding of the concepts involved in modeling relational data.

- Strong analytic skills, with a hands-on approach with the ability to deliver commitments.

- Superior organizational skills, with a disciplined approach to implementation, support, and documentation.

- Experience with ETL of data from a variety of sources using SSIS, Python, or similar technologies (is a plus).

- Knowledge of SQL Server database architecture (components and processes of the database) and/or experience with creating tabular data models in SQL Server (is a plus).

- Advanced English level.

Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.

If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Profissional de vendas - camaçari/ba
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Profissional de vendas - camaçari/ba em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Responsabilidades e Atribuições Gerenciar a carteira de grandes clientes de Camaçari e arredores, garantindo retenção, rentabilidade e expansão dos negócios. Acompanhar e atuar sobre indicadores comerciais, como vendas, inadimplência e repasse, utilizando dados para direcionar decisões e estratégias comerciais. description:

Overview of the role:

We are looking for a Business Intelligence Analyst to join our team. This professional will be responsible for taking raw information – numbers or qualitative data sets – and constructing narratives that help our business colleagues to make better decisions. The primary goal of this position is to take large volumes of complex data, extract insights, and help solve problems.

Key responsibilities:

- Work with stakeholders to understand reporting needs, identifying and querying data sources to get the required data.

- Cleanse and massage data into the shape required, creating Tableau datasets, reports, and dashboards to meet requirements.

- Strong analytic skills, with a hands-on approach with the ability to deliver commitments.

- Superior organizational skills, with a disciplined approach to implementation, support, and documentation.

- Experience with ETL of data from a variety of sources using SSIS, Python, or similar technologies (is a plus).

- Knowledge of SQL Server database architecture (components and processes of the database) and/or experience with creating tabular data models in SQL Server (is a plus).

- Advanced English level.

Benefits:

Elaborar e atualizar o Forecast, garantindo acuracidade, consistência dos drivers e alinhamento com a estratégia do negócio. Executar e manter as rotinas de pricing da Empresa, assegurando coerência entre custos, margens, impostos, políticas comerciais e estratégia competitiva. Analisar dados de vendas, custos, margens e preços vigentes, recomendando ajustes de preço com base em rentabilidade, elasticidade, posicionamento de mercado e sustentabilidade financeira. Realizar estudos de precificação de novos produtos, considerando custos, impostos, margens-alvo, benchmark de mercado e impacto no portfólio. Analisar a rentabilidade por produto, linha, cliente e canal, recomendando ações para melhoria de margem e mix. Suportar os processos de gestão, controle e análise das verbas comerciais, assegurando correta alocação, execução e mensuração de retorno (ROI). Monitorar impactos das ações comerciais nos resultados, margens e indicadores financeiros. Analisar e consolidar informações de vendas, custos e despesas, garantindo aderência ao planejado. Produzir relatórios gerenciais de resultados e desempenho financeiro, com análises críticas e recomendações executivas. Realizar apresentações e reuniões com áreas internas para demonstração de resultados, análises financeiras e orçamentárias. Analisar e liberar requisições de compra, conforme políticas internas e orçamento aprovado. Apoiar o desenvolvimento técnico dos demais membros da equipe de Controladoria, disseminando boas práticas. Executar suas atividades em conformidade com normas técnicas, procedimentos internos, políticas de qualidade, segurança do trabalho e meio ambiente. Realizar outras atividades correlatas, compatíveis com o cargo, conforme orientação do superior imediato. Requisitos: Ensino superior completo em Administração, Economia ou áreas correlatas. Disponibilidade para atuação 100% presencial em Feira de Santana - BA. Excel avançado incluindo modelagem financeira e construção de modelos de pricing, margem e rentabilidade, uso avançado de funções (ÍNDICE, CORRESP, SOMASES, PROCV/XLOOKUP, SE, MATRIZ, LET, LAMBDA), Tabelas Dinâmicas avançadas, Power Query e Power Pivot para tratamento, consolidação e análise de grandes volumes de dados. Vivência com planejamento financeiro, orçamento e Forecast, com domínio de análise de variações (Real x Orçado / Forecast) e identificação de drivers de resultado. Vivência com custos e formação de preços incluindo conceitos de custo standard, custo médio e margem de contribuição, sistemas de custeio (absorção, real e padrão) e análise de rentabilidade por produto, linha, cliente e canal. Experiência com pricing e rentabilidade, com capacidade de modelar preços considerando custos, impostos, margens-alvo, mix e estratégia comercial, realizar simulações de cenários e análises de impacto econômico-financeiro e suportar negociações comerciais com dados, argumentos e análises estruturadas. Experiência com gestão e controle de verbas comerciais, incluindo análise de retorno sobre investimento (ROI), mensuração de impactos em margem, volume e resultado e acompanhamento da execução orçamentária das ações comerciais. Conhecimento em impostos indiretos (ICMS, PIS, COFINS) e seus impactos na formação de preços, margens e rentabilidade e nos princípios de contabilidade e finanças, com capacidade de análise de demonstrações financeiras, reconhecimento de receitas e despesas e entendimento dos impactos contábeis nas decisões de negócio. Conhecimento do processo comercial e logístico, entendendo seus reflexos em custos, preços, nível de serviço e capital de giro. Conhecimento com ferramentas de BI e visualização de dados (Power BI, Tableau ou similares), com capacidade de construir dashboards gerenciais e executivos, analisar indicadores como margem, pricing waterfall, ROI de verbas comerciais, forecast accuracy e traduzir dados complexos em insights claros para tomada de decisão. Experiência com manipulação e análise de bases de dados massivas, garantindo consistência, rastreabilidade e governança da informação. Experiência com Sistemas Integrados (ERP), com habilidade para extração, validação e cruzamento de dados financeiros e comerciais e entendimento dos impactos de cadastros, condições comerciais e impostos nos resultados. Desejável Inglês (leitura, escrita e conversação). Todas as informações fornecidas serão usadas exclusivamente para o processo seletivo. A RGE somente coletará, utilizará, processará ou divulgará informações pessoais quando e onde for permitido pelas leis aplicáveis. Somente os candidatos pré-selecionados serão contatados para entrevista. Nos empenhamos em responder a todos os candidatos. title: Padeiro
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Padeiro em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Resumo do Objetivo da Função

Responsável por toda a cadeia produtiva de panificação, desde o recebimento e armazenamento de insumos congelados até a finalização e exposição dos produtos na área de venda. O Padeiro atua como garantidor da qualidade, segurança alimentar e eficiência operacional da padaria, assegurando que cada item chegue ao cliente com o padrão de frescor e apresentação exigido pela Emporyum Prime.

Responsabilidades Principais

Gestão de Insumos

● Receber, conferir e armazenar pães congelados e demais insumos de padaria, respeitando as temperaturas e prazos de validade indicados pelos fornecedores

● Organizar o estoque seguindo o princípio PVPS (Primeiro que Vence, Primeiro que Sai), garantindo a rotatividade adequada dos produtos

● Registrar lotes e datas de recebimento para rastreabilidade e controle sanitário

Processo Produtivo

● Conduzir o processo de fermentação natural e câmara de crescimento, respeitando os tempos, temperaturas e condições ambientais especificados para cada tipo de massa

● Operar fornos industriais com precisão nos parâmetros de temperatura, umidade e tempo de assamento

● Monitorar indicadores visuais e sensoriais (coloração, textura, aroma) para garantir o ponto ideal de cada fornada antes da disponibilização para venda

Produção Diversificada

● Elaborar salgados assados e fritos (coxinhas, empadas, esfihas, quibes, folheados) seguindo receituário padrão e especificações de peso e formato

● Produzir doces de padaria (bolos, tortas, biscoitos, sonhos, brigadeiros, pudins) com consistência de sabor, textura e apresentação

● Executar decoração básica e finalização de produtos confeitados para vitrine

Gestão de Estoque e Controle de Perdas

● Realizar inventário diário de insumos e produtos acabados, registrando entradas, saídas e quebras

● Monitorar e reportar o KPI de perda (percentual de desperdício sobre produção total), propondo ações corretivas quando o indicador ultrapassar o limite estabelecido

● Identificar produtos próximos ao vencimento e acionar a área comercial para estratégias de giro rápido (promoções, combos, doações internas)

Exposição

● Repor e organizar as gôndolas e vitrines de venda, garantindo sortimento visual equilibrado e exposição atrativa dos produtos

● Manter etiquetas de preço, informações de validade e identificação de alergênicos visíveis e atualizados

● Assegurar que a área de padaria esteja limpa, organizada e em conformidade com as normas sanitárias (ANVISA/BPF) durante todo o horário de funcionamento

Requisitos e Habilidades Desejadas

Escolaridade

● Ensino fundamental completo (obrigatório)

● Curso técnico em Panificação, Confeitaria ou Gastronomia (desejável)

Experiência

● Mínimo de 1 ano em funções de padaria, panificação ou confeitaria

● Experiência comprovada com fermentação natural, fornos industriais e produção em escala

● Vivência em estabelecimentos de alimentação com alto padrão de qualidade (diferencial)

Habilidades Essenciais

Competência

Por que é importante

Organização e disciplina operacional

O processo produtivo exige sequenciamento preciso de etapas (fermentação, modelagem, assamento) — um desvio quebra o fluxo e compromete a disponibilidade de produtos na loja

Atenção a normas sanitárias

A manipulação direta de alimentos exige rigor absoluto com higiene, temperaturas e boas práticas de fabricação para garantir a segurança do consumidor e a conformidade legal

Capacidade de trabalho sob pressão

O ritmo de produção é determinado pela demanda da loja — horários de pico exigem agilidade sem abrir mão da qualidade

Precisão e consistência técnica

Cada fornada deve reproduzir o padrão estabelecido — variações em peso, ponto de cozimento ou apresentação afetam diretamente a experiência do cliente e a margem de perda

Proatividade e senso de dono

O Padeiro é o guardião do estoque e do desperdício — antecipar necessidades de insumos e agir sobre produtos próximos ao vencimento reduz perdas e melhora a rentabilidade

Diferenciais

title: Data analyst
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Data analyst em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Position Summary

The Data Analyst supports the company’s data and analytics initiatives by designing, developing, and maintaining dashboards, reports, and data solutions that provide actionable insights to leadership and stakeholders. This role is responsible for transforming complex data into clear, meaningful visualizations and analysis to support data-driven decision-making. The Data Analyst partners with technical teams and business stakeholders to ensure data accuracy, accessibility, and usability. This position contributes to advanced analytics, forecasting, and continuous improvement of reporting capabilities.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Design, develop, and maintain dashboards and reports using Power BI. Build and maintain data models, custom measures, and calculations using DAX and Power Query. Analyze and validate data from multiple sources to ensure accuracy, consistency, and usability. Write, optimize, and maintain SQL queries for data extraction, transformation, and reporting. Present insights, trends, and findings clearly to executive leadership and non-technical stakeholders. Develop predictive models and apply forecasting and statistical techniques to support business planning. Leverage Azure Data Factory, Databricks, and Microsoft Fabric to support advanced analytics solutions. Partner with stakeholders to define reporting requirements and deliver analytics solutions aligned with business needs. Educate and support teams on data concepts, reporting tools, and analytics best practices. Operate effectively in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment while managing multiple priorities. Additional duties and responsibilities assigned due to business needs.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

Strong proficiency in Power BI, including DAX, Power Query, and data modeling. Strong SQL skills with the ability to extract, transform, and analyze data efficiently. Experience with Azure Data Factory, Databricks, and Microsoft Fabric. Ability to present complex data clearly and effectively to non-technical audiences. Knowledge of predictive analytics, forecasting, machine learning, and statistical analysis techniques. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail. Passion for data visualization, continuous learning, and process improvement. Ability to collaborate effectively with technical and business stakeholders. Strong organizational, time-management, and prioritization skills.

Education, Training, and Experience

High school diploma required; college degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, or a related field preferred. 3+ years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or a related role required. 3+ years of hands-on experience with Power BI required. Demonstrated experience developing dashboards, reports, and data models required. Experience working with cloud-based data platforms and analytics tools preferred. Experience presenting data insights to leadership and non-technical audiences preferred.

title: Client services assistant
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Client services assistant em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Client Services Assistant

Remote, Latin America

Velocity Work helps law firm owners build firms that are profitable, organized, accountable, and not dependent on the owner holding everything together.

We’re hiring a Client Services Assistant to become a true backbone for our team.

This is not a “wait for instructions” role. It’s for someone who sees loose ends, tracks the moving pieces, asks smart questions, and makes the system better without needing someone to hover.

You’ll support current clients, client data, retreat prep, onboarding, internal systems, pipeline tracking, and podcast scheduling. The work is detailed, important, and very real.

If you like being the person who knows where things stand, what’s missing, and what needs to happen next, this may be a great fit.

What You’ll Own -----------

Client Services Operations

This is the center of the role.

You’ll help keep current client work moving cleanly: data workflows, dashboards, retreat materials, onboarding, Hub Spot notes, scheduling details, internal reports, recordings, client folders, and recurring team systems.

You’ll also help catch what’s slipping before it becomes a problem: missing data, unclear ownership, stalled tasks, unlogged client context, messy files, late follow-ups, or anything that makes Client Services feel less prepared.

The goal is simple: current clients feel cared for, Client Services feels supported, and the team trusts that the operational details are handled.

Pipeline + Relationship Tracking

You’ll help us track important non-client relationships: incoming leads, meetings, deals, contracts, key dates, next steps, and handoffs.

You won’t be the salesperson or the primary external email owner. You’ll keep the system accurate so the right person can follow through well and Client Services can provide a high-touch experience before someone becomes a client.

Podcast Scheduling + Production Coordination

You’ll help keep our podcast schedule realistic and ahead of the calendar.

That means protecting planning time, suggesting recording days that match the production schedule, tracking key dates, and flagging when we need to record multiple episodes ahead because the business calendar is getting full.

You won’t own content, writing, editing, or creative direction. This is schedule, process, and timeline management.

This Role Is a Fit If You:

• Notice gaps and communicate them early

• Take ownership without needing to be chased

• Track details carefully and follow through completely

• Ask smart questions, then remember the answer

• Can support a busy team without adding noise

• Stay calm when priorities shift

• Take pride in being reliable, thorough, and useful

This Role Is Not a Fit If You:

• Need detailed instructions for every task

• Wait to be told what to do next

• See problems but don’t speak up

• Think “done” means “mostly handled”

• Struggle when a process is not perfectly documented

Requirements

• Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills

• Clear written and verbal English

• High ownership and follow-through

• Strong attention to detail

• Comfort with ambiguity and shifting priorities

• Experience with calendars, spreadsheets, CRMs, project management tools, and modern Saa S systems

• Fast, stable internet connection

• Professional presence on video

Tools may include Click Up, Hub Spot, Slack, Google Workspace, Zoom, Loom, Fireflies, reporting dashboards, spreadsheets, and podcast scheduling tools.

Work Setup

Remote, Latin America preferred

Contractor, 40 hours/week with meaningful overlap with U. S. business hours

Compensation: $1000/mo USD (you will invoce your hours)

How to Apply

We care about experience, but we care more about ownership, judgment, communication, and follow-through.

You’ll submit:

• Your resume

• A short video introducing yourself and telling us why this role speaks to you

• Anything else that helps us understand how you think and work

We will follow up with a shortlist of prospects and request a Sample Project submission that will demonstrate aspects of the work you'll be doing, and we will compensate you for the time that takes.

We’re looking for someone who wants to become a real operational partner to the team, not just complete assigned tasks.

If you’re the kind of person who sees the gap, owns the follow-through, and makes the whole team feel more organized, we want to meet you.

We’re looking for a seasoned, high-output engineer who can develop our rapidly growing agent platform for our Revenue organization. This individual will sit on our Infrastructure team that builds AI-native solutions used by the entire company to find, convert, and better enable customers with the products we launch. The ideal candidate possesses 3+ years of architecting and developing full-stack applications, proficient data analytics skills, strong interest in agentic workflows, and 5+ years working on applications or codebases built with Python, Databricks, React/JavaScript/TypeScript, and AWS.

You’ll be responsible for production-grade systems that our customers and internal teams depend on daily. That means being responsive, reliable, and an excellent communicator — both when things are going well and especially when they’re not.

The ideal candidate treats AI coding tools as core infrastructure for how they work — not a novelty. You’ve shipped full-stack applications, you’re comfortable navigating ambiguity, and you are customer-obsessed in your approach to improving software.

As a Senior Software Engineer, You Will

  • Own features and systems end-to-end across multiple product surfaces — architecture, implementation, deployment, and iteration
  • Architect and deliver solutions for our Revenue, Revenue Operations, and Business Development teams – including data tools, applications, and agentic orchestrators
  • Serve as a subject matter expert across the whole stack, and report directly to the Chief Architect, who will provide hands-on mentorship in cutting‑edge AI-native development, big data analytics, and cloud infrastructure.
  • Collaborate closely with the Revenue organization, discovering opportunities, projects, and areas to revamp critical business processes with AI
  • Drive initiatives across teams — you’re not waiting for a PM to write a spec; you’re in the room shaping what gets built and why
  • Leverage AI tools like Claude Code, Cursor, Codex to improve personal productivity, ship trustworthy solutions faster through harness engineering, code quality, and documentation.
  • Produce clear documentation: create playbooks, docs, and training materials to institutionalize best practices.

You Are Likely To Succeed If

  • You have 5+ years of hands-on software development experience with a proven track record of shipping customer-facing applications — and the impact to show for it
  • You are stack-flexible: comfortable working across Python, TypeScript/React, and cloud infrastructure (AWS, Databricks). You learn new tools fast and don’t let unfamiliar tech slow you down
  • You have an AI-accelerated workflow — you actively use AI coding tools to ship faster, not as an experiment, but as how you work every day
  • You thrive in ambiguity — you can take a vague business problem, break it down, and deliver a working solution without heavy-handed direction
  • You are a strong communicator who can work directly with non-technical stakeholders, translate between business needs and engineering tradeoffs, and drive alignment
  • You are responsive and reliable — you take ownership of production systems and communicate proactively, especially under pressure
  • You have a bias toward action and ownership — you see a problem, you fix it; you see an opportunity, you ship it
  • You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, STEM, or a related technical discipline
  • Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher)

What We Offer:

You will have regular career conversations with your manager where you will discuss your short and long-term career goals.
